global_base_contract: Computed at final static link, recorded in header word24 and used for relocation; measured579A/7FFF values are not fixed interfaces. GLOBAL_BASE8000 is logical staging only.
known_limits: Public I/O hook variables retain the existing full runtime contract.
CHN static bounds account for known stack demand, so large frames near End may be rejected more conservatively.
IDE options preview the most recent compiled layout; the final compile rechecks the current layout.
Taking the address of a zero-width unit global at module-data end is unsupported; program one-past globals and empty record types remain supported.
Chain/Execute retain the existing full borrowed-runtime/coordinator contract.
The pre-existing standalone zscreentest resident overflow remains; see runtime-placement-evidence.json. Shipped CRT is covered by compact programs, initialization and graphics examples.
CPU-stack window remains C800-FC00; recursive depth is guarded.
Physical-board/NMI and audio-waveform acceptance are not established by these emulator tests.
